title: Auto Test Harness
summary: A personal project's architecture document (BB_BUDDY_ARCHITECTURE_V2.md) sketching a synthetic-data engine that trains on 'golden fixtures' and generates realistic multi-table test data for a property/asset management system. The design describes fitting SDV's HMASynthesizer on relational data with a Metadata schema and sampling new synthetic table sets from the saved model.
